wait_seconds.description: view status: wait up to this many seconds (at most 120) for a running collection to finish

data_file.description: view config: the exact name of one of the organization's data files (see data_files in the result) to also read its inferred NQE schema

data_connector.description: view config: the exact name of one of the network's data connectors (see data_connectors in the result) to also read its endpoints, proxy/collector and last connectivity test result

include_content.description: view config, with data_file: also return the first 2000 characters of the file's stored content, unredacted. Off by default because an uploaded file can hold secrets
